entities.name: Ibrahim Tanko Muhammad
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ibrahim Muhammad Tanko   was a Nigerian jurist, who served as a Justice of the Supreme Court of Nigeria from 2006 to 2022 and as Chief Justice of Nigeria from 2019 until his resignation in June 2022. He was formerly a Justice of the Nigerian Courts of Appeal.
